responsibility: Contains the machine-independent Darwin option table consumed by GCC’s option generator. It declares Darwin target and driver options such as -fapple-kext, -mconstant-cfstrings, -mfix-and-continue, -mmacosx-version-min, -mtarget-linker, and the large set of Darwin linker-style driver options (-dynamiclib, -bundle, -framework-related switches, export lists, segment controls, and many obsolete compatibility flags). Its responsibility is option metadata—names, classes, variables, aliases, and help text—not the implementation of those options.
same_name_distinction: This is the option-description file in the Darwin group: it enumerates Darwin target and driver switches for GCC's option generator, unlike darwin.h which sets macros/specs and darwin.cc which implements Darwin backend behavior.
